grain: One record per fictional purchase order
data_notice: Named business examples; all orders, amounts, dates and delivery metrics are fictional.

supplier_fields.name: supplier_id
supplier_fields.definition: Stable demonstration identifier SUP-A through SUP-D; not an identifier supplied by a business

supplier_fields.name: supplier_label
supplier_fields.definition: Public business name used only as an illustrative label; does not establish a real purchase-order relationship

fields.name: supplier_id
fields.definition: Identifier matching a record in the suppliers collection

fields.name: order_date
fields.definition: Booking date; determines the period for purchase order value

fields.name: promised_date
fields.definition: Promised receipt date; cannot precede order_date

fields.name: received_date
fields.definition: Single full receipt event; cannot precede order_date or coexist with cancelled_date

fields.name: cancelled_date
fields.definition: Single cancellation event; cannot precede order_date or coexist with received_date

fields.name: order_value_cents
fields.definition: Nonnegative full order-level value in USD cents; not a payment or invoice measure

date_convention: YYYY-MM-DD; period_start inclusive, period_end exclusive, as_of inclusive
as_of_state: Before order_date the order does not exist. By received_date it is received. By cancelled_date it is cancelled. Otherwise it is open.
empty_rate: JSON null when there are no eligible received orders
provenance: Independently generated fictional operational records with public business names; no employer or client data or schema
business_context: Staccato Bakery, Abstinence Spirits and Grow The Earth are publicly listed in SupplyBistro's Cornell Marketplace network. Good Four Season Trading is publicly described by SupplyBistro as an early partner and discovery source; its Cornell affiliation is not established.
attribution_scope: The fictional results are not actual client financial impact or evidence that Ziana Bennett worked with each named business.
